notablePrerequisites: Gauntlets of Light attached to Magda.
description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Magda, adding {W}.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {W}, untapping Magda.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.
